memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anaemia and vitamin B12 deficiency.
Patient is a 24‑year‑old male cab driver presenting with fatigue, mild exertional dyspnoea and pallor. Examination shows conjunctival pallor, mild tachycardia, no organomegaly. He follows a mixed diet with limited red meat intake. No smoking, alcohol occasional.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 9.8 g/dL (13.0‑17.0). Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (15‑150). MCV 78 fL (80‑100). Serum vitamin B12 180 pg/mL (200‑900).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-07-05 at 10:00 am with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anaemia and vitamin B12 deficiency.
Patient reports improved energy, less breathlessness on exertion. Mild pallor persists. Vital signs stable. No adverse symptoms from medications.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 11.6 g/dL (13.0‑17.0). Serum ferritin 48 ng/mL (15‑150). MCV 82 fL (80‑100). Serum vitamin B12 340 pg/mL (200‑900).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling much better now; fatigue only after long drives. No side effects from tablets. Want to know if I can reduce the iron tablets.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anaemia and vitamin B12 deficiency.
Patient notes fatigue only after prolonged driving; otherwise well. Examination shows mild pallor, vitals normal. Adherence good.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 12.9 g/dL (13.0‑17.0). Serum ferritin 78 ng/mL (15‑150). MCV 84 fL (80‑100). Serum vitamin B12 410 pg/mL (200‑900).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed: original slot 2026-01-20 moved to 2026-01-20 at 11:30 am with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Iron-deficiency anaemia and vitamin B12 deficiency.
Patient denies fatigue, feels normal. No pallor noted. Vital signs within normal range. No medication side effects.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 13.4 g/dL (13.0‑17.0). Serum ferritin 112 ng/mL (15‑150). MCV 86 fL (80‑100). Serum vitamin B12 460 pg/mL (200‑900).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Ferrous sulfate stopped
Methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Vitamin B12 deficiency (now resolved).
Patient asymptomatic, labs show normal haemoglobin and B12. No pallor. Advises to maintain balanced diet; B12 supplement can be tapered.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Haemoglobin 14.2 g/dL (13.0‑17.0). Serum ferritin 95 ng/mL (15‑150). MCV 88 fL (80‑100). Serum vitamin B12 520 pg/mL (200‑900).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: All good. No tiredness even after long shifts. Have stopped B12 tablets as advised; feeling fine.
